==English==

===Etymology 1===
From {{der|en|la|ob-}}.

====Prefix====
{{en-prefix}}

# {{lb|en|non-productive}} Against; facing; {{n-g|a combining prefix found in verbs of Latin origin}}.
# {{lb|en|botany}} Of a reversed shape.

=====Synonyms=====
* {{sense|against}} {{l|en|anti-}}, {{l|en|counter-}}, {{l|en|contra-}}, {{l|en|dys-}}

=====Derived terms=====
{{prefixsee|en}}

===Etymology 2===
{{clipping|en|obligatory}}.

====Prefix====
{{en-prefix}}

# {{lb|en|Internet|informal|humorous}} [[obligatory|Obligatory]]; [[prepend]]ed to the name of a topic being mentioned to avoid accusations of being [[off-topic]].
#* {{quote-newsgroup|en|year=1998|author=Haydn Black|title=lesbian goths|newsgroup=alt.gothic
|passage='''ObGoth''': Uh, well, it's like this you see, &lt;searches in random file o' obgoth things&gt; anyone out there got the new CoX album on Tess? If so which album is it *most* like?}}
#* {{quote-newsgroup|en|year=1998|author=Peter Thomas|title=FAQ: more info request|newsgroup=comp.sys.sinclair
|passage=Aren't Newcastle's chairman Sunderland supporters? (From the way they acted?) Erm...'''obspeccy'''? Tynesoft, eh? What happened to them?}}
#* {{quote-newsgroup|en|year=2000|author=Dan Glover|title=Introduction to Linux article for commentary|newsgroup=alt.linux
|passage='''ObLinux''': SAP were giving away a free development environment for use with RedHat v6.1 recently, a distinctly non-free complete system has been available for a while. This offers another example of a commercial application where the vendors now have sufficient confidence in Linux to release a port (even if it is distribution-specific).}}

* {{l|en|thread tax}}

==Latin==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|la|obs-}}
* {{alter|la|os-}}
* {{alt|la|op-||pronunciation spelling}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|la|ob}}
Prefixation of preposition {{m|la|ob||towards; against}}.

===Prefix===
{{head|la|prefix}}

# [[towards]]; [[against]]

====Usage notes====
In compounds, the '''b''' is often (from the data of derived terms below, one fourth of the times) assimilated into the next consonant producing a [[geminate#Noun|geminate]].

====Derived terms====
{{prefixsee|la}}

==Polish==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|pl|obe-}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|pl|id=around|:inh|zlw-opl:ob-<id:around>|text=+|tree=1|doublet=o-}}

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-ob-.wav}}

===Prefix===
{{head|pl|prefix}}

# {{ng|prefix added to verbs to mean surrounding, around}}
#: {{prefixusex|pl|jechać|objechać}}
#: {{syn|pl|o-}}
# {{ng|prefix added to verbs meaning entirely}}
#: {{prefex|pl|ob-|jeść|t2=to eat|[[objeść]] [[się]]|t3=to eat and be overstuffed}}

Because the prefix ends with the consonant sometimes the first letter of the verb was dropped.
#: {{prefixusex|pl|źrzeć|obejrzeć}}
#: {{prefixusex|pl|walić|obalić}}

{{prefixsee|pl}}

* {{alt|sh|o-||usually before plosives, sometimes also other consonants}}
* {{alt|sh|op-||before unvoiced consonants}}

===Etymology===
{{inh+|sh|sla-pro|*ob}}, from {{der|sh|ine-pro|*h₃ebʰi}}. See {{m|sh|o}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|sh|/ob/}}

===Prefix===
{{sh-prefix}}

# [[around]], [[enclosing]], [[surrounding]]
#: {{l|sh|jahati}} → {{l|sh|objahati}}
#: {{l|sh|grliti}} → {{l|sh|obgrliti}}
#: {{l|sh|kružiti}} → {{l|sh|okružiti}}
# [[around]], [[throughout]], [[wholly]]
#: {{l|sh|javiti}} → {{l|sh|objaviti}}
#: {{l|sh|uzeti}} → {{l|sh|obuzeti}}
#: {{l|sh|lizati}} → {{l|sh|oblizati}}
# on the surface or top of something
#: {{l|sh|grepsti}} → {{l|sh|ogrepsti}}
# {{non-gloss|forms perfective verbs from imperfectives}}
#: {{l|sh|hrabriti}} → {{l|sh|ohrabriti}}
# [[quite]], [[-ish]]
#: {{l|sh|malen}} → {{l|sh|omalen}}

{{prefixsee|sh}}

==Slovak==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|sk|obo-}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|sk|:inh|zlw-osk:ob-<ety:inh<sla-pro:*ob-<ety:from<*ob>>>>|text=+|tree=+}} Cf. {{m|sk|o}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{sk-IPA}}

===Prefix===
{{head|sk|prefix}}

# [[circum-]], [[peri-]] ({{n-g|prefix used to denote an action performed on the surface, around the edge, or the circumference of an object}})
#: {{prefixusex|sk|sekať|obsekať<t:to trim around/off>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|viazať|obviazať<t:to tie around/bandage>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate that a state or action affects only the exterior or surface of an object}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|horieť|obhorieť<t:to be scorched on the surface>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|schnúť|obschnúť<t:to dry on the surface>}}
# [[circum-]] ({{n-g|prefix used with verbs of motion to indicate movement following a perimeter or circling an object}})
#: {{prefixusex|sk|ísť|obísť<t:to go around/bypass>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate a sequence of actions or movements visiting all individual points or objects in a set}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|letieť|obletieť<t:to fly around/visit all by flying>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|behať|obbehať<t:to run around/visit all by running>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used with frequentative verbs to denote a repetitive action or continuous presence in a certain area}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|stávať|obstávať<t:to loiter/stand around>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|sedávať|obsedávať<t:to sit around/haunt (e.g. pubs)>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used with stative verbs to indicate the acquisition of a specific property or state over time}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|starnúť|obstarnúť<t:to grow old/stale>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|-živnúť|obživnúť<t:to come to life/revive>}}
# [[re-]], [[be-]] ({{n-g|prefix used to indicate the conferring or bestowing of a quality or thing expressed by the word base}})
#: {{prefixusex|sk|nový|obnoviť<t:to renew/restore>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|čerstvý|občerstviť<t:to refresh>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate the capacity or ability to perform or stay in a certain state despite difficulty}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|sedieť|obsedieť<t:to remain seated/stay on (e.g. a horse)>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|stáť|obstáť<t:to stand one's ground/pass a test>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate the direct targeting or thorough processing of a specific object or task}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|robiť|obrobiť<t:to till/cultivate/process>}}

====Derived terms====
{{prefixsee|sk}}
